description: This Python source file implements a module for controlling speech-to-text (STT) muting based on various strategies and conditions. It defines classes and enums to configure muting behavior, and a processor class that manages muting state during a conversation by processing different frame types related to speech events.

classes.name: STTMuteStrategy
classes.description: Enumeration of strategies for muting speech-to-text processing during different conversation states.

classes.name: STTMuteConfig
classes.description: Configuration dataclass for specifying muting strategies and optional custom muting callback.

classes.name: STTMuteFilter
classes.description: A frame processor class that manages muting and interruption control based on conversation frames and strategies.

methods.name: __post_init__
methods.description: Validates the muting strategies set in the configuration to ensure incompatible strategies are not used together.

methods.name: _handle_mute_state
methods.description: Handles changing the muting state and logs the change.

methods.name: _should_mute
methods.description: Determines whether the STT should be muted based on current state and configured strategies.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to update muting state and suppress or pass frames accordingly.
